title: NDVI basics — single-band NDVI product (scene: water / vegetation)

assertions.derivation: Lab grid contract: EPSG:4326, 128x128 at 0.001 deg; a submission on another grid is not comparable to the known answer.
NDVI=(N-R)/(N+R) is bounded by [-1,1] for non-negative reflectance (KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX spectral family). Catches display stretches (x100+50) and unit slips.

Closed form over the committed scene: 4096 water pixels at ndvi(0.02,0.03)=-0.2 and 12160 valid vegetation pixels at ndvi(0.50,0.08)=21/29 (128 declared-invalid inputs are NoData). mu=(4096*(-0.2)+12160*(21/29))/16256=0.49129053; two-point population sigma=0.401235.
The scene input declares 128/16384=0.78% invalid pixels; a correct product masks them (ratio 0.0078). Ratio 0 = forgot to mask; ratio > 0.05 = masked usable data. Both directions are wrong.
The scene has exactly two surface states (water -0.2, vegetation 21/29); the NDVI histogram must be bimodal with well-separated modes. Catches stretches that smear the classes.
